errors.evidence: The horizontal axis shows 27 countries and the EU average, for a total of 28 items, not 31.
The countries on the x-axis are not arranged alphabetically (e.g., LV, RO, HU...). They are sorted by the total height of the bars in ascending order.

errors.text_span: Вертикалната ос представлява процента на общите разходи за енергия, вариращ от 0% до 25%
errors.evidence: This incorrectly describes the vertical axis. The chart has two vertical axes. The primary left axis represents costs in Euros (€), which corresponds to the bars. The right axis represents percentages, corresponding to the orange diamond markers. The description incorrectly implies the main vertical axis for the bars is in percent.
The description completely omits the primary left y-axis, which shows the cost in Euros (€) from 0 to 3,000.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете са подредени по азбучен ред.
errors.evidence: This is a repetition of a previous error. The bars are sorted by their total height in ascending order, not alphabetically by country code.
The legend indicates that "Твърди горива" (solid fuels) are represented by the color purple, not orange. The orange color corresponds to the diamond markers.
The legend indicates that "Природен газ" (natural gas) is represented by the color red, not green. The color green represents "Течни горива" (liquid fuels).
The chart legend does not contain an item named "Дял на енергията за бита". The dark blue segment represents "Електроенергия" (Electricity).
The chart legend does not contain an item named "Дял на енергията за домакинствата (цялото)". The orange diamond markers represent "Дял на енергията за домакинствата (вдясно)".
This incorrectly implies that the orange element is a segment of the stacked bar. The orange diamond markers are a separate data series plotted as a scatter plot, corresponding to the right y-axis.
The highest bar in the chart (for Denmark, DK) reaches approximately 2,600€. No value exceeds 3,000€, which is the maximum value on the y-axis scale.
The description fails to mention the existence of the second data series, the orange diamond markers, which represent the 'Share of energy for households' and are plotted against the right y-axis.
